instruction.german: Read and look at the rules in the grammar box. Find four regular and four irregular past simple verbs in the text Figure it out.

configs.text:
Figure it out

Jordan Geller – trainer collector Jordan Geller always |loved| expensive trainers, even when he was a small child! He |tried| to get some Air Jordans when he was very young, but they were very expensive. So he |waited| until he was at university. There, he |got| his first pair of Air Jordans for $125. After that, he |bought| and |sold| hundreds of pairs of trainers and he |opened| his own shoe museum in 2009. By 2013, Jordan |had| more than 2,000 pairs of trainers.

staticText.text:
Grammar | Past simple affirmative

We use the past simple to describe actions that happened in the past.

Regular verbs

To form the past simple of regular verbs:

• add -ed to most regular verbs: played, talked

• add -d to verbs ending in -e: liked, used

• double the last letter and add -ed to verbs ending in a vowel + consonant: stopped, dropped

• change the -y to -i and add -ed to verbs ending in a consonant + y: carried, studied

Irregular verbs

Many verbs in English have irregular past simple forms:

come – came; go – went; take – took;

know – knew
